story.iWant: to create an account with my email and a secure password
story.soThat: I can access the AI Study Buddy's features
story.tasks: <task id="1"> <description>Create Registration UI</description> <acceptance-criteria ref="1,2" /> <subtask>Create a new page at `/register`.</subtask> <subtask>Build a form with fields for email and password.</subtask> <subtask>Implement client-side validation for email format and password strength.</subtask> </task> <task id="2"> <description>Implement Registration API Endpoint</description> <acceptance-criteria ref="1,2" /> <subtask>Create a Next.js API route at `/api/auth/register`.</subtask> <subtask>Use Supabase client to call `supabase.auth.signUp()`.</subtask> <subtask>Handle success and error cases (e.g., email already in use).</subtask> </task> <task id="3"> <description>Testing</description> <acceptance-criteria ref="1,2" /> <subtask>Write unit tests for the registration form validation.</subtask> <subtask>Write an integration test for the `/api/auth/register` endpoint.</subtask> <subtask>Manually test the end-to-end registration flow.</subtask> </task>

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: <criterion id="1"> <description>**Given** I am on the registration page, **when** I enter a unique email and a password meeting the requirements (5 letters, 1 number, 1 special symbol), **then** my account is successfully created, and I am logged in.</description> </criterion> <criterion id="2"> <description>**And** if I enter an email already in use, I receive a message and an option to reset my password.</description> </criterion>

constraint.description: Passwords must meet criteria: minimum 5 letters, 1 number, 1 special symbol.
If a user attempts to register with an existing email, the system must inform them and offer a 'Forgot Password' option.
User authentication must be handled by Supabase Auth.
Client-side and server-side validation for password strength must be implemented.
User data must be protected by Row Level Security (RLS).
Account must be temporarily locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.

tests.standards: Testing will involve a combination of unit tests for client-side validation and API routes, integration tests for the authentication flow and RLS policies, and end-to-end tests for the complete user registration process. Manual testing will also be performed for edge cases.

ideas.idea: Unit test client-side form validation for valid email and strong password.
Integration test `POST /api/auth/register` endpoint with valid new user data.
Integration test `POST /api/auth/register` endpoint with an existing email.
E2E test: Successfully register a new user and verify login.
E2E test: Attempt to register with an existing email and verify the error message and 'Forgot Password' option.
Manual test: Verify password strength requirements are enforced on the UI.
